I Called the Abyss Lord a Puppy

Chloe Valentine has a simple rule: if it hurts, help it. That rule becomes dangerous when the nearsighted veterinarian stumbles into a clinic for creatures everyone else fears. A snarling hellhound needs a gentle hand. The dreaded Abyss Lord gets the sort of attention usually reserved for a wayward pet. Chloe barely understands the terror surrounding her, yet each patient she helps becomes an unexpected ally. In a realm where power inspires obedience, one human woman's kindness is winning something far harder to command: devotion.
